descriptions.w3d_d27a_entry_weight_pass_80018ce0: For each entry of the table at 0x804aa750, sums into 0x8041d3b8 a penalty from entries whose weight has the opposite sign and lie within 100 units, adds a bonus scaled by settings +164 when the nearest such entry is at least 1000 away, then adds every sum to the entry's weight at +12.
